The redesign is in place. The unit tests pass (114 of 114), but the browser tests on the four iPhone/iPad layouts and the offline check are still running; I'll report their result when they finish. Nothing is committed or deployed yet.

**Reference used.** The museum page and the Hungarian site both refused the simple fetch (403). Your mercedes-benz.hu link did load in the local headless browser, so I matched its measured styles:
- **Header and hero:** a black header bar, and a full-width photo hero with a large serif headline.
- **Page and headings:** a white page with dark grey `#333` headings.
- **Cards:** black cards with 12 px corners, where the photo fades into black under a white title.
- **Buttons:** pill-shaped, in MB blue `#0078d6` for the main action, plus a black-pill selector like their brand switcher.

**Index page**
- A black header bar ("Under the skin" on the left, "Unofficial tour notes" on the right), then a full-width hero using the W 196 R hall photo, with a "See the route" button.
- On phones the hero photo sits above the text and fades into black, as on their mobile site.
- Every stop is now a photo card with a "Stop n · year" tag, the car name, its summary and a blue pill listing its mechanisms. Cards are grouped under large room headings ("Legend 1", "Level 8 · 7 stops").
- The cards reuse each stop's existing `photo.jpg`, which the offline cache already stores, so nothing new is downloaded. Images load lazily.

**Stop pages**
- The same black header bar ("← Tour route" and stop position), serif titles and pill-shaped Component/View selectors.
- The 3D view and side panels have rounded corners. The museum-photo overlay still lines up.

**Things you should know**
- **Font:** MB's headline font is proprietary, so I used Instrument Serif instead, a similar condensed serif that is free to use (OFL licence). It is stored locally in `lib/app/fonts/` (21 KB, with its licence file), so offline mode still works.
- **Dark mode is kept:** phones set to dark get a black version of the same design. The header bar, hero and cards stay black in both modes.
- **Photo credit fixed:** the index footer used to credit every photo to Valder137, but the Daimler engine photo is by another photographer. The credit line is now built from each car's photo data.
- **Other edits:** the stop's header bar is now static markup in `stop.html` (the old breadcrumb row was removed from `lib/app/shell.js`), the app colours in `manifest.webmanifest` changed, and CLAUDE.md notes the new design and font.
- **Still to check:** I checked the pages in screenshots at iPhone and desktop sizes, in light and dark, with no console errors and no sideways scrolling. A look on a real iPhone/iPad is still worth doing.
